description: Search DHgate products, browse categories and seller shops, or fetch individual product pages.

containsKeyword.description: Only emit products whose title contains this keyword (case-insensitive).
containsKeyword.title: Contains keyword

country.description: Quotes prices and shipping for this destination and keeps products whose detail page reports the same destination.
country.title: Shipping country

freeShippingOnly.description: Keep only products that ship free.
freeShippingOnly.title: Free shipping only

includeDetails.description: Also open each product page to fill wholesale price tiers, variants, shipping, specifications and supplier reputation. Slower but much richer records.
includeDetails.title: Fetch full product details

maxMoq.description: Keep products whose minimum order quantity is at most this number, e.g. 1 for single-unit orders.
maxMoq.title: Maximum minimum-order quantity

maxPages.description: Pagination safety cap for search, category and shop pages.
maxPages.title: Max pages per source

maxPrice.description: Drop products whose lowest price is above this.
maxPrice.title: Max price (USD)

minPrice.description: Drop products whose lowest price is below this.
minPrice.title: Min price (USD)

minRating.description: Drop products whose seller rating is below this (0–5).
minRating.title: Min seller rating

minSold.description: Keep only products whose listing shows at least this many recent sales.
minSold.title: Minimum sold count

proxyConfiguration.description: Optional. Only tried after a direct request is blocked; the actor does not need a proxy.
proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration

shopId.description: DHgate supplier shop ID, e.g. `22268785`. Found in store URLs: dhgate.com/store/22268785.
shopId.title: Shop ID (mode=shopProducts)

startUrls.description: Product, category, store or search URLs, e.g. `https://www.dhgate.com/product/designer-bag/1086662889.html`.
startUrls.title: DHgate URLs (mode=byUrl)

title: DHgate Scraper Input
